name: AcHorizontalAnchor
description: Used with the HorizontalAnchor property to specify how a control is anchored horizontally within its layout.

constants.name: acHorizontalAnchorLeft
constants.description: The control is anchored to the left side of its layout.

constants.name: acHorizontalAnchorRight
constants.description: The control is anchored to the right side of its layout.

constants.name: acHorizontalAnchorBoth
constants.description: The control is stretched horizontally across its layout.
